shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo`#9 at `277e7f2`; it now meets the NeurIPS 2026 requirements I can check.

- **Fonts:** `pdffonts` lists no Type 3 font. `paper-repo` switched `\texttt` to Bera Mono at 0.8 scale instead of the Courier fix I suggested, and that works.
- **Length:** the main text ends on page 9, References start on page 10 and the checklist is on page 12.
- **Format:** US Letter, `neurips_2026` with no option, "Anonymous Author(s)", and `template/` files identical to the official kit.
- **Anonymity:** no identifying URLs or addresses in `paper/*.tex`, and no TODO left.
- **Figure text:** it is now at least 6.9 pt. The only 6 pt text is the style's line numbers.

Page 9 is full, so any text added later needs a page-count recheck.
